title: Scroll of Summon Quasit

sources.title: Scrolls
markers: A character of any class can cast

summary: Summon the Cheeky Quasit familiar, which can turn Invisible and use Scare.

fields.Cast: Level 1. Spend an Action and consume the scroll. No spell slot required.
fields.Effect: Summon the Cheeky Quasit familiar, which can turn Invisible and use Scare. A Wizard can transcribe the scroll. Follow the pinned item for the separate permanent dialogue route.
fields.Scroll rules: Any class can cast this in BG3 if able to cast spells. Applicable attack rolls and saves use your proficiency bonus and item spellcasting ability. A Counterspelled scroll is not consumed.

changes: Added exact native BG3 scroll activation, spell mechanics, and shared item-casting rules from pinned sources. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
